name: Middle Eastern Spiced Lamb Chops with Fatoush Salad & Turmeric-Raisin Rice (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.

Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water, raisins, turmeric, and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup basmati rice
1 cup water
¼ cup raisins
½ tsp turmeric, ground
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
1 pint grape tomatoes
½ English cucumber
½ bunch radish
½ small pkg fresh mint
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ head romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp honey
1 tsp sumac, ground
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Place half on a plate, then add remaining tomatoes to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add half to the plate with the tomatoes and set aside. Add remaining cucumber to the bowl.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; shave parsley leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut or tear pita into 1-inch pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pita and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until pita is golden and crispy, 2-3 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice rub. Pat the lamb chops dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with the spice rub on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp coriander, ground
½ tsp salt
⅛ tsp cayenne pepper
4 lamb loin chops

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes. (Wipe skillet clean and reserve for later use.)
While the chops are cooking, place eggs, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.

Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are set, then remove from heat.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies, along with 1 cup of crispy pita, then toss to combine the salad.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide scrambled eggs, plain tomatoes, cucumbers, remaining crispy pita, and raisins between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide chops, rice, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
